# powerhmc_network_bridge (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a NetworkBridge on an IBM Power Systems managed system. Looks up the bridge by its `pvid` (Port VLAN ID). All attributes are read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing NetworkBridge on a managed system by bridge PVID.
data "powerhmc_network_bridge" "bridge" {
  system_name = "managed-system"
  pvid        = 100
}

output "bridge_id" {
  description = "UUID of the NetworkBridge."
  value       = data.powerhmc_network_bridge.bridge.id
}

output "failover" {
  description = "Whether SEA failover is enabled."
  value       = data.powerhmc_network_bridge.bridge.failover
}

output "load_sharing" {
  description = "Whether load sharing across VIOSes is enabled."
  value       = data.powerhmc_network_bridge.bridge.load_sharing
}

output "primary_vios_sea_name" {
  description = "Device name of the Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) on the primary VIOS."
  value       = data.powerhmc_network_bridge.bridge.primary_vios.sea_name
}

output "virtual_networks" {
  description = "Virtual networks attached to this NetworkBridge."
  value       = data.powerhmc_network_bridge.bridge.virtual_network
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pvid` (Number) Bridge Port VLAN ID used to look up the NetworkBridge.
- `system_name` (String) Name of the parent ManagedSystem.

### Read-Only

- `failover` (Boolean) Whether SEA failover is enabled.
- `id` (String) UUID of the NetworkBridge assigned by the HMC.
- `jumbo_frame` (Boolean) Whether jumbo frames are enabled on the SEA.
- `large_send` (Boolean) Whether TCP large-send offload is enabled on the SEA.
- `load_group` (Attributes Set) All load groups defined on the bridge, including the default load group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--load_group))
- `load_sharing` (Boolean) Whether load-balancing across VIOSes is enabled.
- `primary_vios` (Attributes) Primary VIOS backing the NetworkBridge SEA. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--primary_vios))
- `qos_mode` (String) Quality-of-service mode on the SEA (`"disabled"` | `"strict"` | `"loose"`).
- `secondary_vios` (Attributes) Secondary VIOS for SEA failover. Null when failover is not configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secondary_vios))
- `virtual_network` (Attributes Set) Virtual networks attached to this NetworkBridge. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_network))

<a id="nestedatt--load_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_group`

Read-Only:

- `primary_slot_number` (Number) Virtual slot number for the trunk adapter on the primary VIOS.
- `pvid` (Number) PortVLANID for this load group.
- `secondary_slot_number` (Number) Virtual slot number for the trunk adapter on the secondary VIOS.
- `vlan_ids` (Set of Number) Set of virtual network VLAN IDs assigned to this load group.


<a id="nestedatt--primary_vios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `primary_vios`

Read-Only:

- `adapter_id` (Number) Numeric adapter ID of the backing device.
- `backing_adapter` (String) Physical Ethernet adapter on the VIOS (e.g. `ent5`).
- `configuration_state` (String) Configuration state of the SEA (e.g. `"Configured"`).
- `description` (String) Description of the backing adapter.
- `gateway` (String) Default gateway of the SEA interface. Empty when not configured.
- `high_availability_mode` (String) HA mode of the backing SEA (`"disabled"` | `"auto"` | `"standby"` | `"sharing"`).
- `ip_address` (String) IP address configured on the SEA interface. Empty when not configured.
- `name` (String) VIOS partition name.
- `physical_location` (String) Physical location code of the backing adapter.
- `sea_name` (String) Device name of the SEA on the VIOS (e.g. `ent5`).
- `slot_number` (Number) Virtual slot number for the trunk adapter on the VIOS.
- `subnet_mask` (String) Subnet mask of the SEA interface. Empty when not configured.

- `ip_address` (String) IP address configured on the SEA interface. Empty when not configured.

- `sea_name` (String) Device name of the SEA on the VIOS (e.g. `ent5`).

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_network`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the virtual network.
- `tagged` (Boolean) Whether the network uses IEEE 802.1Q tagged frames.
